beats.motion_prompt: A hand casually typing a quick short message on a phone, a small pawn resting beside it. Camera: slow push-in 5 percent over 5 seconds, relaxed, no shake. Subject: the thumb taps out a couple of quick taps and a light flick to send, effortless and unhurried, the pawn still beside the hand. Environment: soft warm light steady, faint screen glow flickering as content changes out of focus. Atmosphere: a trivial everyday task, no effort needed. 5 seconds, photorealistic documentary realism, no CGI. Negative: readable text forming, fast frantic typing, morphing hand, extra fingers, jitter, sudden zoom, glowing UI popping in, distortion.
